setup.name: setup-02-python
setup.cmd: python -c "import urllib.request as u; B='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/munimtechnologies/delphi-dimuon-30gev/main/'; [u.urlretrieve(B + p, '/work/' + p.split('/')[-1]) for p in ('xkin/xme.py', 'xkin/evana.py', 'xkin/fadgen.py', 'xkin/run_xkin.py', 'analysis/lep4f.py', 'analysis/eff4f.py', 'analysis/efhz.py', 'analysis/lephz.py', 'analysis/kly.py', 'analysis/run_kly4f.py')]"

run_steps.name: run-01-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python -m py_compile run_klyscan.py test_klyscan.py run_kly4f.py kly.py lephz.py efhz.py eff4f.py lep4f.py xme.py evana.py fadgen.py run_xkin.py > /out/compile.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/compile.txt; grep -h 'VERSION = ' run_klyscan.py kly.py lephz.py eff4f.py lep4f.py xme.py; sha256sum *.py | tee /out/sha256.txt; exit $rc

run_steps.name: run-02-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python -m unittest -v test_klyscan > /out/tests.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/tests.txt; exit $rc

run_steps.name: run-03-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python run_klyscan.py --out /out --nsig 8000 --workers 2 --budget-min 40 > /out/run.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/run.txt; exit $rc
